items.title: FAQs
items.html:
What is non-fluoride mouthwash?
Non-fluoride mouthwash is a type of oral care rinse that does not contain fluoride, a common ingredient found in many traditional mouthwashes. Instead, it relies on Hydroxamin® (a blend of nano-hydroxyapatite with vitamins K2 & D3) to help support enamel health, freshen breath, and promote a balanced oral environment.
Why would someone choose non-fluoride mouthwash over traditional mouthwash?
Some individuals may prefer fluoride free mouthwash due to concerns about fluoride consumption, especially if they already receive fluoride from other sources such as fluoride toothpaste or fluoridated drinking water.
What are the benefits of using fluoride free mouthwashes?
Non-fluoride mouthwash with hydroxyapatite can still provide benefits such as freshening breath, reducing plaque buildup, and fighting germs without the use of fluoride. It may also be a preferred option for those with certain sensitivities or allergies to fluoride.
Can non-fluoride mouthwash be used by children?
Yes, children 6 and older can use non-fluoride mouthwashes, but for children younger than 6, it's generally recommended to avoid it since they may not have fully developed their swallowing reflexes. For older children, supervision is key to ensure they spit it out mouthwash properly.
Can non-fluoride mouthwash be used as a substitute for brushing and flossing?
Non-fluoride mouthrinse is not a substitute for brushing and flossing, which are essential components of good oral hygiene. While no fluoride mouthwash can complement these practices by freshening breath and reducing germs, it should not replace thorough mechanical brushing and flossing of the teeth and gums with a toothbrush and toothpaste and dentist office visits for oral care.
Why is there a tiny hole on the cap of my mouthwash?
That’s not a hole—it’s a one-way pressure-release membrane that prevents leaks or bursts during shipment, especially by air. It allows air to escape but not liquid, so your mouthwash remains sealed and safe.

items.title: HOW TO USE
items.html: Use twice a day — once in the morning before brushing and once in the evening after brushing Use 10 ml (two teaspoons) and swish for one minute. Spit out.
